# DataXAPI: every endpoint

> 258 endpoints, one line each: the name (linked to the whole contract), the request, the price, what comes back. Base URL `https://api.dataxapi.com`. How to call, pay and handle errors is the same everywhere: https://dataxapi.com/llms.txt

Generated from catalog revision ceced48b38f71468, price book 30.

## Douyin

- [Douyin comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the replies under a Douyin comment, by the comment's ID and its video's ID: text, replier, likes, time posted.
- [Douyin hashtag videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/hashtags/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/hashtags/videos/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Douyin videos under a hashtag, by the hashtag's ID, in the platform's order, most liked first or newest first: caption, author, engagement counts, time posted.
- [Douyin trend-index brand trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/brands/history.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/brands/history` $0.002 per call. Get a brand's day-by-day search, content and spread indexes on Douyin over a date range, from the platform's own index tool. An index is the platform's score, not a count; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [Douyin trend-index brand comparison](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/brands/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/brands/metrics` $0.002 per call. Get the daily averages of a brand's search, content and spread indexes on Douyin over a date range, from the platform's own index tool, with the averages of every brand in its industry and of the industry's top 3, 5, 10, 15 and 30 to hold them against. An index is the platform's score, not a count.
- [Douyin trend-index creator top videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/creators/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/creators/videos/list` $0.002 per call. Get the videos the platform's own index tool lists as a Douyin account's top videos for a span of up to 30 days, by the account's numeric ID: up to twenty, most liked first, each with caption, link, day published, its engagement counts and followers gained. As recorded, the tool picks from what was published on the last day or two of the span, not from all of it: set the end date to the day you want. One page; no view counts.
- [Douyin trend-index creator follower profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/creators/audience/get` $0.002 per call. Get who follows a Douyin account from the platform's own index tool, by the account's numeric ID: the share of each segment by gender, age, province, city, city tier, phone brand and interest. Not limited to marketplace creators; shares only, no head counts.
- [Douyin trend-index creator core metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/creators/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/creators/metrics` $0.002 per call. Get a Douyin creator's core figures from the platform's own index tool, by the account's numeric ID: new likes, shares and comments a day and the tool's own count of follows a day, on average over the last week and the last month, each as a ratio against the period before. The follows are not the net gain in followers, and come out larger. An account the tool has nothing on (every figure 0) is answered as not found.
- [Douyin trend-index keyword audience](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/keywords/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/keywords/audience/get` $0.002 per call. Get who is behind a keyword on Douyin over a date range, from the platform's own keyword tool: the share and TGI of each age group, gender, province, city, city tier and interest.
- [Douyin trend-index keyword trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/keywords/history.md) `GET|POST /v1/douyin/index/keywords/history` $0.006 per call. Get the day-by-day search index and composite index of a keyword, or of one to five keywords at once, on Douyin over a date range, from 巨量算数 (the Douyin index), with the daily averages of the period, of the one before and of a year earlier. An index is the platform's score of volume, not a count of searches; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [Douyin trend-index related keywords](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/keywords/related` $0.002 per call. Get the keywords related to a keyword on Douyin in one week, from the platform's own keyword tool: those searched together with it and those that appear with it in content, each with its relevance, its place by relevance, its search index and its composite index. An index is the platform's score of volume, not a count of searches.
- [Douyin trend-index live hot topics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get the live topic board or the fastest-rising topic board of Douyin's index tool, about 30 entries each: place, name, topic index, number of related videos, their plays and a category. The topic index is the platform's score of heat, not a count of searches.
- [Douyin trend-index keyword hot videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/index/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/index/videos/search` $0.002 per call. Get the roughly 20 high-index videos Douyin's index tool puts forward for a keyword: caption, link, author's display name, likes, video index and category. One page only; the author's ID and the publication time are not given, the video endpoint has them.
- [Douyin hot search board](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get a Douyin hot list: hot searches, rising topics, topic ranking, top search terms or the music chart, with rank and heat.
- [Douyin user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/users/get` $0.002 per call. Get a Douyin user's profile by account ID or profile link: name, handle, bio, follower, following and post counts, total likes, verification; in the full view also what the badge says, whether it is an organisation's or shop's (blue V), whether the profile has a product showcase, whether the account may sell live, and whether it is live now, with the room's ID.
- [Douyin creator engagement and follower trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/history.md) `GET|POST /v1/douyin/users/history` $0.002 per call. Get how a Douyin account's numbers moved over the last 7 or 30 days, by its numeric ID, from the platform's own index tool: net new followers, new likes, comments, shares and posts, each as a ratio against the period before, and the totals now; up to five accounts in one request. It is one period's sum, not a day-by-day series.
- [Douyin user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/users/search` $0.002 per call. Search Douyin accounts by terms, a page at a time: account ID, display name, avatar, follower count, post count, total likes.
- [Douyin user videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/users/videos/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the videos a Douyin account has posted, newest first: caption, engagement counts, time posted.
- [Douyin video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of comments on a Douyin video: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [Douyin video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Douyin video or image post by ID or link: caption, author, engagement counts, time posted.
- [Douyin video transcript (video to text)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/transcript/get` $0.002 a call, plus $0.0038 a minute when the speech is recognised (a part minute counts as one); none when the platform's own captions are used; at most $0.021 per call for a video of up to 5 minutes, a longer one, up to 2 hours, by its actual minutes. Give a Douyin video's link, share text or ID and get what is said in it: the whole text, each sentence with its start and end time, and ready SRT subtitles, with the title, author and length; speakers can be told apart. Charged a call, plus by the minute of video when its speech is recognised; nothing when nobody speaks. A video of up to 5 minutes comes back as text; one over 5 minutes and up to 2 hours is answered at once with a job: call again with it a little later for the text, charged by its actual minutes and only when the text is delivered.
- [Douyin video play count](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/metrics` $0.002 per call. Get a Douyin video's counts as of now, by its ID: plays and likes.
- [Douyin related videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/related.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/related` $0.002 per call. Get the batch of videos Douyin recommends beside a video, by its ID: caption, author, engagement counts. The recommendations may differ from call to call.
- [Douyin video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/search` $0.02 per call. Search Douyin videos by terms, a page at a time, sorted by relevance, newest or most liked and filtered by time posted: caption, author with follower count, engagement counts.
- [Douyin trending videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/trending.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/trending` $0.002 per call. Get a Douyin video board for the last day: breakouts from small accounts, highest like rate, highest completion rate or highest follow rate, with plays, likes and the author's follower count.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator rate card](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/rates/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/rates/get` $0.04 per call. Get what a Douyin creator charges on Xingtu for each kind of sponsored work, and how it is settled.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/search` $0.004 per call. Search Douyin creators on Xingtu by words in their name, filtered by followers, expected CPM (in yuan) and gender, or ordered by expected CPM, lowest first:Xingtu creator ID, name, location, content categories, followers; in the full view also what an integrated and a custom video cost, expected CPMs (in yuan), expected views, the last 30 days' interaction and completion ratios and median views, the e-commerce level, gender and content labels. The creator ID the other Xingtu endpoints take comes from here.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/get.md) `GET|POST /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/get` $0.004 per call. Get a Douyin creator's profile on Xingtu by Xingtu creator ID: name, location, content categories, followers, gender; one ID also gives the Douyin account ID, handle, agency and content labels, several IDs (up to 50) give what an integrated and a custom video cost, their expected CPMs (in yuan) and the views expected of a video instead.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator audience](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/audience/get` $0.004 per call. Get who follows a Douyin creator, by Xingtu creator ID: followers and share in each segment by gender, age, province, city, city tier, interest, device, consumer group, purchase category and purchase amount.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/metrics.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/metrics` $0.004 per call. Get how a Douyin creator's videos did over the last 30 or 90 days, by Xingtu creator ID: videos, median views, average likes, comments and shares, engagement and completion ratios, expected cost per thousand views and per interaction (in yuan). The figures are of all the videos: the platform gives none for the sponsored ones alone.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator video performance](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/videos/list` $0.004 per call. Get a page of a Douyin creator's videos by Xingtu creator ID, newest first, with the figures Xingtu gives for each: views, likes, completion and engagement ratios, length. Sponsored and everyday videos come together: the platform neither marks which are sponsored nor gives the sponsored ones alone.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator content keywords](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/keywords/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/keywords/get` $0.002 per call. Get the words Xingtu takes from a few of a Douyin creator's recent videos, by Xingtu creator ID: about twenty, each with how many times it was counted (usually single digits). They often come from one or two videos, which may be a sponsored one: a news outlet's account was found to return nothing but skincare words. They do not stand for the creator's content as a whole; for that, use the Xingtu content mix endpoint.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator index scores](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/scores/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/scores/get` $0.008 per call. Get the six scores Xingtu gives a Douyin creator, by Xingtu creator ID: the overall Xingtu score and those for reach, seeding, conversion, cooperation and value for money, each with the score, the average of comparable creators, the rank and how far from the top that rank is.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator content mix](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/content_mix/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/content_mix/get` $0.004 per call. Get what a Douyin creator's recent videos are about, by Xingtu creator ID: the number of videos in each of the marketplace's content categories and their share. It shows whether the creator keeps to one subject.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator conversion](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/creators/conversion/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/creators/conversion/get` $0.004 per call. Get how well a Douyin creator's product videos sell, by Xingtu creator ID: videos counted, their median views, products recommended, the bands that sales, sales per thousand views, product price, cost per click, product-link clicks and click rate fall in, and the categories of goods. A band is the platform's text, not an exact figure; for most creators tried, a seller of e-commerce level L4 among them, every band was empty (null), and a creator with no selling figures is answered as not found.
- [Douyin Xingtu marketing calendar](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/campaigns/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/campaigns/list` $0.004 per call. Get the campaigns on Xingtu's marketing calendar over a span of time: platform events, e-commerce and seasonal moments, creative and industry campaigns, each with its name, description, kind, stage, sign-up period and running period. All at once, no paging.
- [Douyin Xingtu video report: plays and completion rate](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/videos/get` $0.004 per call. Get Xingtu's report on one Douyin video by ID or link: plays and engagement counts, plus the completion rate, interaction rate, length, the author's followers and the author's Xingtu creator ID (to look up the creator's rates and metrics next). Only for videos Xingtu covers (mostly its creators').
- [Douyin search suggestions](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/douyin/keywords/related` $0.02 per call. Get the suggestions Douyin's search box lists as a keyword is typed into it (autocomplete), in the order it lists them, about 10 at a time. The words and their places only, with no index.
- [Douyin live search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/lives/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/lives/search` $0.02 per call. Find Douyin streamers by Douyin ID or nickname and whether they are live right now: account ID, Douyin ID, nickname, avatar, followers, whether live, and while live the room's ID and title. A topic word (games, say) usually finds nothing.
- [Douyin video downloader, no watermark](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/videos/media/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/videos/media/get` $0.002 per call. Give a Douyin video or image post by ID, link or share text and get the address of every file it has: the video without watermark in each quality (with the platform's play address beside it), the cover, the background music, and each picture of an image post as a JPEG with its live photo video. The addresses need no headers; where a signature says when one expires, expires_at says so, and another call gives new ones.
- [Douyin music detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/music/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/music/get` $0.002 per call. Get one piece of Douyin music by its ID: name, author, length, the address of its audio file (mostly an MP3), cover, whether Douyin marks it as commercial music (in its commercial music library), whether it is a video's original sound, and how many people have posted with it. The ID is that of a video's background music, or an id of the music chart.
- [Douyin user videos (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/backup/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/douyin/backup/users/videos/list` $0.03 per call. The backup of Douyin user videos, to call when the original cannot serve: the same parameters and result, at a higher price.
- [Douyin video search (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/backup/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/douyin/backup/videos/search` $0.03 per call. The backup of Douyin video search, to call when the original cannot serve: the same parameters and result, at a higher price.
- [Douyin Xingtu creator audience (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/douyin/xingtu/backup/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/douyin/xingtu/backup/creators/audience/get` $0.04 per call. The backup of Douyin Xingtu creator audience, to call when the original cannot serve: the same parameters and result, at a higher price.

## Bilibili

- [Bilibili comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of replies to a Bilibili comment, by the comment's ID and its video's BV number: text, replier, likes, what it answers, time posted.
- [Bilibili hot searches](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get Bilibili's current hot search terms, up to 50, with rank, heat and the words the list shows for each.
- [Bilibili user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/users/get.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/users/get` $0.002 per call. Get a Bilibili user's profile by user number: name, bio, avatar, verification and what it says, follower and following counts, number of videos, likes received in all, account level, live room link.
- [Bilibili user videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/users/videos/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the videos a Bilibili user uploaded, newest first: title, description, views, comments, danmaku count, length, time published.
- [Bilibili video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of comments on a Bilibili video by BV number, top or newest first: text, commenter and their level, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [Bilibili video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Bilibili video by BV number or link: title, description, uploader, views, likes, coins, saves, danmaku count, length, tags, section, IP location, and the cid that subtitles and danmaku are asked for by.
- [Bilibili video transcript (video to text)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/transcript/get` $0.004 a call, plus $0.0038 a minute when the speech is recognised (a part minute counts as one); none when the platform's own captions are used; at most $0.023 per call for a video of up to 5 minutes, a longer one, up to 2 hours, by its actual minutes. Give a Bilibili video's link or BV number and get what is said in it: the whole text, each sentence with its start and end time, and ready SRT subtitles, with the title, uploader and length; speakers can be told apart. A video in several parts is transcribed from its first. Charged a call, plus by the minute of video when its speech is recognised; nothing when nobody speaks. A video of up to 5 minutes comes back as text; one over 5 minutes and up to 2 hours is answered at once with a job: call again with it a little later for the text, charged by its actual minutes and only when the text is delivered.
- [Bilibili video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/search` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Bilibili videos for search terms, by relevance, newest or most played: title, uploader, views, likes, saves, comments, length.
- [Bilibili popular videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/trending.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/trending` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Bilibili's popular videos: title, description, uploader, views, likes, coins, saves, danmaku count, length, section, IP location, why it is recommended.
- [Bilibili video downloader](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/videos/media/get.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/videos/media/get` $0.002 per call. Give a Bilibili video by BV number or link and get its picture in each quality and its sound in each quality, apart (with width, height, codec, bit rate, backup addresses and when each expires). Fetch every address with the header Referer: https://www.bilibili.com, join picture and sound with ffmpeg, and once they expire, call again.
- [Bilibili user videos (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/bilibili/backup/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/bilibili/backup/users/videos/list` $0.03 per call. The backup of Bilibili user videos, to call when the original cannot serve: the same parameters and result (without the description and the comment count), at a higher price.

## Kuaishou

- [Kuaishou comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the replies under a Kuaishou comment, by the comment's ID and its video's ID: text, replier, likes, time posted, IP location.
- [Kuaishou hot list](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get Kuaishou's hot list: 50 trending terms and whatever the platform pins above them, with rank and heat.
- [Kuaishou user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/users/get.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/users/get` $0.02 per call. Get a Kuaishou user's profile by user ID: name, handle, bio, follower, following and post counts, total likes, verification; in the full view also what the badge says, the IP location, gender, and whether the profile has a Kuaishou store.
- [Kuaishou user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/users/search.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/users/search` $0.02 per call. Search Kuaishou accounts by terms, a page at a time, with only verified accounts or only those live now, by gender, or ordered by followers: user ID, display name, handle, bio, follower count, verification.
- [Kuaishou user videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/users/videos/list` $0.02 per call. With sort=popular: $0.002 per call. Get a page of the videos a Kuaishou account has posted, newest or most popular first: caption, play and engagement counts, time posted.
- [Kuaishou video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of top-level comments on a Kuaishou video: text, commenter, likes, time posted, IP location.
- [Kuaishou video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/videos/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Kuaishou video by ID or link: caption, author, play and engagement counts, time posted.
- [Kuaishou video transcript (video to text)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/videos/transcript/get` $0.002 a call, plus $0.0038 a minute when the speech is recognised (a part minute counts as one); none when the platform's own captions are used; at most $0.021 per call for a video of up to 5 minutes, a longer one, up to 2 hours, by its actual minutes. Give a Kuaishou video's link, share text or ID and get what is said in it: the whole text, each sentence with its start and end time, and ready SRT subtitles, with the caption, author and length; speakers can be told apart. Charged a call, plus by the minute of video when its speech is recognised; nothing when nobody speaks. A video of up to 5 minutes comes back as text; one over 5 minutes and up to 2 hours is answered at once with a job: call again with it a little later for the text, charged by its actual minutes and only when the text is delivered.
- [Kuaishou video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/videos/search` $0.02 per call. Search Kuaishou posts by terms, a page at a time, sorted newest or most liked first and filtered by time posted and video length: caption, author, play and engagement counts, time posted, whether it is a video or a photo set, and a video's length.
- [Kuaishou video downloader](https://dataxapi.com/apis/kuaishou/videos/media/get.md) `GET /v1/kuaishou/videos/media/get` $0.002 per call. Give a Kuaishou video or photo set by ID, link or share text and get the address of every file it has: the video in each quality (with width, height, bit rate, size and backup addresses) and its cover; for a photo set, each picture and the music under it. The addresses need no headers; once one stops working, another call gives new ones.

## Telegram

- [Telegram channel profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/telegram/channels/get.md) `GET /v1/telegram/channels/get` $0.002 per call. Get a public Telegram channel by its handle: name, description, subscriber count, verification.
- [Telegram channel messages](https://dataxapi.com/apis/telegram/channels/messages/list.md) `GET /v1/telegram/channels/messages/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of a public Telegram channel's messages by its handle, newest first: text, time posted, views, images.

## Weibo

- [Weibo comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of replies to a Weibo comment by comment ID: text, replier, likes, what it answers, time posted, IP location.

- [Weibo post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Weibo post by ID: the whole text (of a long post too), author, likes, comments, reposts, reads (plays on a video post), pictures, topics, IP location.
- [Weibo video transcript (video to text)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/transcript/get` $0.002 a call, plus $0.0038 a minute when the speech is recognised (a part minute counts as one); none when the platform's own captions are used; at most $0.021 per call for a video of up to 5 minutes, a longer one, up to 2 hours, by its actual minutes. Give a Weibo video post's link, share text or ID and get what is said in its video: the whole text, each sentence with its start and end time, and ready SRT subtitles, with the post's text, author and length; speakers can be told apart. Charged a call, plus by the minute of video when its speech is recognised; nothing when nobody speaks. A video of up to 5 minutes comes back as text; one over 5 minutes and up to 2 hours is answered at once with a job: call again with it a little later for the text, charged by its actual minutes and only when the text is delivered.
- [Weibo post likers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/likers/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/likers/list` $0.002 per call. Get the accounts that most recently liked a Weibo post by post ID, about 50 at a time: name, bio, avatar, verification and its kind, follower and following counts, number of posts, the gender and region their profiles give.
- [Weibo realtime search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/search` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Weibo posts for search terms, newest first: text (a long post is cut short here), author and follower count, likes, comments, reposts, video plays, pictures, topics.
- [Weibo hot search board](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get Weibo's current hot search list, 50 terms, with rank, heat and label (new, hot and the like).
- [Weibo user followers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/followers/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/followers/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the accounts following a Weibo user, 20 a page: name, bio, avatar, verification and its kind, follower and following counts, number of posts, when the account was opened, the gender and region their profiles give.
- [Weibo user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/get.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/get` $0.002 per call. Get a Weibo user's profile by user ID: name, bio, avatar, verification, follower and following counts, number of posts. It also gives what the verification says, the profile's totals of reposts, comments and likes, gender and region.
- [Weibo user posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/posts/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the posts on a Weibo user's profile (their own and their reposts) by user ID, newest first: text (a long post is cut short here), likes, comments, reposts, video plays, pictures, topics, IP location, whether pinned.
- [Weibo user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/users/search.md) `GET /v1/weibo/users/search` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Weibo users for search terms: ID, name, avatar, profile link.
- [Weibo video and image downloader](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/posts/media/get.md) `GET /v1/weibo/posts/media/get` $0.002 per call. Give a Weibo post by ID, link or share text and get its video in each quality the platform has (up to 4K where there is one, each with width, height, bit rate, size, whether it is watermarked and when it expires) and its cover, or each picture at its largest size. Video and picture posts only: a text post is answered as having no files. The addresses need no headers; once they expire, another call gives new ones.
- [Weibo hot search board (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/weibo/backup/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/weibo/backup/trends/list` $0.03 per call. The backup of the Weibo hot search board, to call when the original cannot serve: the same parameters and result, at a higher price.

## Xiaohongshu (RedNote)

- [Xiaohongshu image search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/images/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/images/search` $0.02 per call. Search Xiaohongshu pictures by terms, a page at a time; each result is one picture with the note it belongs to: the picture's address, the note's title, text, author, likes, comments, saves and shares. Shares are not given here (they always read 0, so they are left out); xiaohongshu.notes.get gives a note's shares.
- [Xiaohongshu note detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/get` $0.02 per call. Get one Xiaohongshu note by ID or link: title, text, author, engagement counts, images. It also says whether it is a brand partnership note on record.
- [Xiaohongshu comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/comments/replies/list` $0.02 per call. Get a page of replies to a Xiaohongshu comment, by the comment's ID and its note's ID: text, replier, likes, time posted, which comment it answers.
- [Xiaohongshu note comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/comments/list` $0.02 per call. Get a page of top-level comments on a Xiaohongshu note by ID or link, newest first or hottest first: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted.
- [Xiaohongshu note search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/search` $0.02 per call. Search Xiaohongshu notes by terms: title, text, author, engagement counts, images, and a link that opens. Each says whether it is a brand partnership note on record. By relevance, newest, most liked, most commented or most saved; video or image notes only; published in the last day, week or half year.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY keyword search index](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/history.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/history` $0.04 per call. Get a keyword's day-by-day search index on Xiaohongshu over about the last three months, from the platform's creator marketplace, with each day's notes about the keyword and how often they were shown, read and engaged with. The platform sets the period; it cannot be chosen. The search index is the platform's index, not a count of searches; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [Xiaohongshu PGY related keywords](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/keywords/related` $0.04 per call. Get what people search on Xiaohongshu before and after a keyword, from the platform's creator marketplace, each with its place by relevance, its search index, the notes about it and their reads: for expanding a seed keyword. The search index is the platform's index, not a count of searches; for a word the platform gives no figures for, these are null.
- [Xiaohongshu topic notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/topics/notes/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/topics/notes/list` $0.02 per call. Get the trending notes under a Xiaohongshu topic by its page ID: title, text, author, engagement counts, images, hashtags.
- [Xiaohongshu topic detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/topics/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/topics/get` $0.02 per call. Get one Xiaohongshu topic by its page ID: name, description, views, the discussion count the page shows, share link.
- [Xiaohongshu trends](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/trends/list` $0.02 per call. Get the hot topics Xiaohongshu suggests to creators: name and the platform's heat score.
- [Xiaohongshu user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/users/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/users/get` $0.02 per call. Get a Xiaohongshu account by user ID or profile link: name, handle, bio, follower, following and note counts, verification, and the gender and region its profile shows.
- [Xiaohongshu user notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/users/notes/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/users/notes/list` $0.02 per call. Get a page of the notes a Xiaohongshu account posted, by user ID or profile link: title, text, engagement counts, images, whether pinned.
- [Xiaohongshu user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/users/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/users/search` $0.02 per call. Search Xiaohongshu accounts by terms: user ID, handle, name, avatar, verification.
- [Xiaohongshu product detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/shop/products/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/shop/products/get` $0.02 per call. Get a product of Xiaohongshu's shop by its ID: title, current and original price in yuan, pictures, rating, reviews, shop. What is seen is the product's page in the app's version for a region abroad (the region may differ from one call to the next): promotions and whether it can be bought may not be what a user in China sees.
- [Xiaohongshu product reviews](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/shop/products/reviews/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/shop/products/reviews/list` $0.02 per call. Get the first page of buyers' reviews of a product of Xiaohongshu's shop by the product's ID: text, rating, variant bought, pictures, likes.
- [Xiaohongshu product search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/shop/products/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/shop/products/search` $0.02 per call. Search the products of Xiaohongshu's shop by terms: title, current and original price in yuan, units sold, picture, shop. What is seen is the shop of the app's version for a region abroad (the region may differ from one call to the next): promotions and whether an item can be bought may not be what a user in China sees.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/search.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/search` $0.04 per call. Find Xiaohongshu creators on PGY by search terms, by the filters of PGY's creator square, or both: followers, the price of a sponsored note, estimated CPM, median reads and interactions of everyday and sponsored notes, image or video creators, content category, content feature, persona, where they are, gender, followers' gender and age, industry worked with lately; leaving out the inactive and those losing followers; ordered by followers, price, reads, interactions, shop visits, cost per read, invitations answered, growth, completion and more. Each with creator ID, name, handle, location, content categories and followers, and in the full view prices and medians. A search goes as far as its first 5,000 creators. The creator ID the other PGY endpoints take comes from here.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/get` $0.04 per call. Get a Xiaohongshu creator's profile on PGY by creator ID: name, handle, location, content categories, followers, and in the full view what an image note and a video note cost, the least a note costs and whether each is open, sponsored notes in all and in the last 30 days, median reads and interactions, gender, content and persona tags, industries worked with, the agency (MCN) and likes and saves in all.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator audience profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/audience/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/audience/get` $0.04 per call. Get who follows a Xiaohongshu creator, by PGY creator ID: the share of each segment by gender, age, province, city, interest and device, and the day the figures are of.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/metrics.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/metrics` $0.04 per call. Get how a Xiaohongshu creator's everyday or sponsored notes did over the last 30 or 90 days, by PGY creator ID: notes and video notes, median impressions, reads, interactions and follows, engagement and completion ratios, the share of notes past 100 and 1,000 likes, the standing among comparable creators, and the share of impressions and reads from the explore feed, search, the following feed and other entry points. The full view adds each note's impressions, reads and interactions and how far each is above the median, and long-term notes (published about half a year back): their recent and long-term reads and where those came from.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/notes/list.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/notes/list` $0.04 per call. Get a page of a Xiaohongshu creator's notes by PGY creator ID (PGY's note cases), with the figures PGY gives for each: reads, likes, saves, shop visitors, whether it was sponsored and for which brand, and whether paid promotion sent it traffic. Sponsored, cross-domain sponsored, image or video notes alone; newest, most read or most engaged first; by content feature or category; reads of organic traffic alone.
- [Xiaohongshu search suggestions](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/keywords/related` $0.02 per call. Get the suggestions Xiaohongshu's search box lists as a keyword is typed into it (autocomplete), in the order it lists them, about 10 at a time. The words and their places only, with no index.
- [Xiaohongshu video note with its video and subtitles](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/videos/get` $0.02 per call. Get one Xiaohongshu video note by ID or link: title, text, author, engagement counts, plus the video file's address, its length, its cover, the Chinese subtitles the platform made (SRT, usable as a transcript) and whether it is a brand partnership note on record. Video notes only; an image note is the note detail's.
- [Xiaohongshu video transcript (video to text)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/videos/transcript/get` $0.02 a call, plus $0.0038 a minute when the speech is recognised (a part minute counts as one); none when the platform's own captions are used; at most $0.039 per call for a video of up to 5 minutes, a longer one, up to 2 hours, by its actual minutes. Give a Xiaohongshu video note's link, share text or ID and get what is said in it: the whole text, each sentence with its start and end time, and ready SRT subtitles, with the title, author and length; the platform's own subtitles where it made them, the speech recognised where it did not, and speakers can be told apart. Charged a call, plus by the minute of video when its speech is recognised (not when the platform's subtitles are used); nothing when nobody speaks. A video of up to 5 minutes comes back as text; one over 5 minutes and up to 2 hours is answered at once with a job: call again with it a little later for the text, charged by its actual minutes and only when the text is delivered.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator follower history](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/followers/history.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/followers/history` $0.04 per call. Get a Xiaohongshu creator's follower count for each of the last 30 or 60 days, by PGY creator ID, with the net gain over the period and that gain as a share. Shows whether a creator is growing, or lost or bought followers all at once.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY similar creators](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/related.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/related` $0.04 per call. Give a PGY creator ID and get the Xiaohongshu creators PGY recommends as similar: creator ID, name, handle, location, content categories, followers, and in the full view what a note with them costs and median reads and interactions. Four a call (PGY shows four a page), usually a handful to a few dozen in all, page by page.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY trending notes](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/notes/trending.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/notes/trending` $0.04 per call. Get the trending notes of PGY's content square: eight boards such as Xiaohongshu hot, product seeding, e-commerce promotion and PGY sponsored, the whole board or the notes about some words, over the last 3, 7, 14 or 30 days, image or video notes only if wanted. Each note with its title, time published, reads, likes, saves, comments and pictures, and the creator's ID, name and followers. No ID needed: a way to find what is working and what to post about.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator costs and data summary](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/costs/metrics.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/costs/metrics` $0.04 per call. Get what a Xiaohongshu creator is expected to cost, by PGY creator ID: the estimated CPM, cost per interaction, cost per read and cost per shop visitor of an image note and of a video note, each with the share of comparable creators it beats; the median impressions, reads, interactions and shop visitors of a note, follower growth and notes published over 30 days, the share of invitations answered within 48 hours and the "easy to reach" mark, active days of the last 7 and the "active" mark, the strength PGY marks, the content mix and the industries worked with. Of everyday or of sponsored notes.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator follower summary](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/followers/metrics.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/followers/metrics` $0.04 per call. Get how much a Xiaohongshu creator's followers are worth, by PGY creator ID: followers and the net gain over 30 days, how many are active, engaged, reading and buying, each as a share of all followers and against comparable creators. Shows whether the followers really read and buy.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY creator core figures history](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/costs/history.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/creators/costs/history` $0.04 per call. Get a Xiaohongshu creator's core figures for each of the last 30 or 90 days, by PGY creator ID: CPM, CPE (cost per interaction), CPV (cost per read), cost per shop visitor, and the median impressions, reads, interactions and shop visitors of a note, with the same figures for the whole period. Of everyday or of sponsored notes: shows whether a creator is getting better or worse value.
- [Xiaohongshu PGY note metrics](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/pgy/notes/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/pgy/notes/get` $0.04 per call. Get the figures PGY shows a brand for one Xiaohongshu note, by note ID: impressions, reads, likes, saves, comments, shares and the follows it brought, the brand it was reported for, the click-through band of the brand's components (comment area, text, bottom), and its title, text, pictures, time published and creator ID. For closing a sponsored note's campaign and checking what a creator delivered. PGY keeps figures for its creators' notes only; a note it has none for (such as a brand's own) is a 404.
- [RedNote (Xiaohongshu) image downloader, originals and live photos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/notes/media/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/notes/media/get` $0.02 per call. Give a RedNote (Xiaohongshu) image note by ID, link or share text and get each picture's address without watermark, at the largest size the platform keeps, with its width, height and format, and for a live photo the address of its video. The addresses need no headers; once they expire, another call gives new ones. Image notes only; a video note's files are xiaohongshu.videos.media.get's.
- [RedNote (Xiaohongshu) video downloader](https://dataxapi.com/apis/xiaohongshu/videos/media/get.md) `GET /v1/xiaohongshu/videos/media/get` $0.02 per call. Give a RedNote (Xiaohongshu) video note by ID, link or share text and get the address of every file of its video, without watermark: each quality in each codec (H.264, H.265 and the like) with its width, height, bit rate and size and backup addresses, the cover, and the subtitle files the platform made (SRT, by language). The addresses need no headers; once one stops working, another call gives new ones. Video notes only; an image note's pictures are xiaohongshu.notes.media.get's.

- [YouTube channel profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/channels/get.md) `GET /v1/youtube/channels/get` $0.002 per call. Get a YouTube channel by ID or handle: name, description, subscriber count, video count, total views, verification, the day it was created, the links its About section lists (its website, its other social accounts) and its keywords.
- [YouTube channel search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/channels/search.md) `GET /v1/youtube/channels/search` $0.002 per call. Find YouTube channels by search terms: name, handle, description, subscriber count, verification.
- [YouTube channel videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/channels/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/youtube/channels/videos/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of a YouTube channel's videos or Shorts by channel ID or handle, newest or most viewed first: title, description, time published, views, likes, length.
- [YouTube comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/youtube/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the replies to a YouTube comment, by the replies token the comment list gives: text, replier, likes.
- [YouTube video comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/videos/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/youtube/videos/comments/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of comments on a YouTube video by ID or link, top or newest first: text, commenter, likes, reply count, and the token that gets a comment's replies.
- [YouTube video detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/videos/get.md) `GET /v1/youtube/videos/get` $0.002 per call. Get one YouTube video by ID or link: title, description, channel, time published, view, like and comment counts, length, and the tags its author set, its category and chapters.
- [YouTube video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/youtube/videos/search` $0.002 per call. Find YouTube videos by search terms, by relevance or by views, within a time window: title, channel, views, length.
- [YouTube video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/youtube/videos/transcript/get` $0.002 per call. Get the transcript of a YouTube video by ID or link: the whole text and timed segments. lang chooses the language of the captions.
- [YouTube channel posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/channels/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/youtube/channels/posts/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the posts on a YouTube channel's Posts tab (once Community) by channel ID or handle, newest first: text, pictures, likes, the video a post carries.
- [YouTube post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/youtube/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/youtube/posts/get` $0.002 per call. Get one YouTube channel post (once a Community post) by ID or link: text, channel, pictures, likes, the video it carries.

- [WeChat Channels account profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/users/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/users/get` $0.02 per call. Get a WeChat Channels account by its ID: name, signature, avatar, IP location, number of videos.

Make a link that opens a WeChat Channels video in WeChat, by the video's ID (it starts with weixin.qq.com/sph/). Each call makes a different link for the same video, and an older one still leads to it; a link cannot be built from the ID.
- [WeChat Channels account collections](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/users/collections/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/users/collections/list` $0.02 per call. Get every public collection of a WeChat Channels account by the account's ID: name, description, cover, number of videos, when it was last updated. A collection's ID is what the endpoint that lists its videos takes.
- [WeChat Channels collection videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/collections/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/collections/videos/list` $0.02 per call. Get a page of the videos in a WeChat Channels collection by the collection's ID, in the collection's own order (oldest first), 20 a page: description, author, time published, likes, comments, forwards, saves.

Get a page of the videos a WeChat Channels account published, newest first, by the account's ID: description, time published, likes, comments, forwards, saves, length.
- [WeChat Channels video search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/videos/search` $0.02 per call. Get a page of WeChat Channels videos for search terms through WeChat Search, by relevance, newest or hottest, filtered by time posted: description, the account's name and avatar, time published, likes and saves, length, cover. WeChat Search gives no account ID, and a video's ID is an encrypted one starting with export/: given as export_id to wechat_channels.videos.get it yields the numeric ID, the video file's address and the key that decrypts it; it expires, so use it soon.
- [WeChat Channels account profile (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/backup/users/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/backup/users/get` $0.03 per call. The backup of wechat_channels.users.get: the same parameters and result, priced on its own. No number of videos.
- [WeChat Channels account videos (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/backup/users/videos/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/backup/users/videos/list` $0.06 per call. The backup of wechat_channels.users.videos.list: the same parameters and result, priced on its own.
- [WeChat Channels video search (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/backup/videos/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/backup/videos/search` $0.1 per call. The backup of wechat_channels.videos.search: the same parameters and result, priced on its own. No saves.
- [WeChat Channels account search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/users/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/users/search` $0.06 per call. Find WeChat Channels accounts by name: the name has to match exactly, and every account of that name is returned, with its ID, name, signature, avatar, whether it is verified and what the verification says. The ID can be passed to the Channels profile, video list, live replay and other endpoints.
- [WeChat Channels video stats](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/videos/metrics.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/videos/metrics` $0.015 per call. Get the latest counts of a WeChat Channels video by its ID: likes, comments, shares, saves, with its description and account. They are not read at the moment of the call and may be a few hours old; the answer says when they were taken. Cheaper than the whole video.
- [WeChat Channels comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/comments/replies/list` $0.015 per call. Get a page of the replies under a comment on a WeChat Channels video, by the comment's and the video's IDs: text, replier, likes, time posted, IP location, which reply each answers. About 10 a page, with further pages.
- [WeChat Channels live replays](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/users/live_replays/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/users/live_replays/list` $0.02 per call. Get the replays of a WeChat Channels account's live streams by the account's ID, newest first, the first page only (up to 48 seen on one): title, time, length, cover, and the replay video's likes, comments, forwards and saves (the counts of the replay as a video, not the stream's viewers or the likes in its room).
- [WeChat Channels video download](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/videos/media/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/videos/media/get` $0.02 per call. Give a WeChat Channels video by its ID, share link or a search result's export/ ID and get the video file's address (with width, height, size and length), the cover, and the method and key that decrypt it: only the first 131072 bytes of a Channels file are encrypted, and once decrypted as decrypt says, it is a playable MP4. Use the address and key of one answer together; no headers are needed. Once the address stops working, another call gives a new pair.
- [WeChat Channels video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_channels/videos/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_channels/videos/transcript/get` $0.02 a call, plus $0.0038 a minute when the speech is recognised (a part minute counts as one); none when the platform's own captions are used; at most $0.039 per call for a video of up to 5 minutes, a longer one, up to 2 hours, by its actual minutes. Give a WeChat Channels video's share link, ID or a search result's export/ ID and get what is said in it: the whole text, each sentence with its start and end time, and ready SRT subtitles, with the caption, author and length; speakers can be told apart. The Channels file is decrypted for you. Charged a call, plus by the minute of video when its speech is recognised; nothing when nobody speaks. A video of up to 5 minutes comes back as text; one over 5 minutes and up to 2 hours is answered at once with a job: call again with it a little later for the text, charged by its actual minutes and only when the text is delivered.

## WeChat Search

- [WeChat Search articles and videos](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat/posts/search` $0.02 per call. Get a page of WeChat Search results for search terms: Official Account articles and Channels videos mixed, each saying in type whether it is an article or a video; by relevance, newest or hottest, filtered by time posted, or articles only or videos only: title or description, the source account's name, time published, an article's link (with a band of reads on some), a video's likes and saves. WeChat Search gives no account ID.
- [WeChat Search articles and videos (backup)](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat/backup/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat/backup/posts/search` $0.1 per call. The backup of wechat.posts.search: the same parameters and result, priced on its own. Videos come without saves.
- [WeChat Official Account live search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat/accounts/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat/accounts/search` $0.02 per call. Find WeChat Official Accounts and service accounts for search terms through WeChat Search, closest first, possibly followed by less related ones: original ID, WeChat ID, name, bio, avatar, whether verified, owner, number of original articles. Charged per call; no followers or reads, for estimates of those use wechat_mp.accounts.search.
- [WeChat Index](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat/index/keywords/history.md) `GET /v1/wechat/index/keywords/history` $0.1 per call. Get a keyword's WeChat Index over the last 30 days, one figure a day. The WeChat Index is WeChat's score of attention across its search, articles, Moments and more, not a count of searches, and is not comparable with Douyin's or Xiaohongshu's; days are calendar days in China time (UTC+8).
- [WeChat Search suggestions](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/wechat/keywords/related` $0.1 per call. Get the suggestions WeChat Search lists in its search box for a keyword, in the order it lists them, about 10 at a time. The words and their places only, with no index.
- [WeChat mini program search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat/miniprograms/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat/miniprograms/search` $0.1 per call. Find WeChat mini programs for search terms through WeChat Search, the first page (about 25): name, description, icon, original ID and AppID, the owner's name and whether it is verified, how many used it lately as the platform shows it, and whether it is a mini game.

## WeChat Official Accounts

- [WeChat Official Account articles](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/accounts/articles/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/accounts/articles/list` $0.02 per call. Get a page of the articles a WeChat Official Account published, newest first: title, digest, link, time published. Each also says whether it was the lead article or one below, its format and cover. The page's articles tab by default; its videos or pictures tab when asked.
- [WeChat Official Account profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/accounts/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/accounts/get` $0.02 per call. Get a WeChat Official Account by its original ID: name, IP location, number of original articles, the linked Channels account, whether it is banned.
- [WeChat Official Account article comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/articles/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/articles/comments/list` $0.02 per call. Get a page of the featured comments on a WeChat Official Account article by its link: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted, IP location, whether it is pinned.
- [WeChat Official Account article detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/articles/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/articles/get` $0.02 per call. Get one WeChat Official Account article by its link: title, text, time published, the account's name and IDs. It also says whether it was the lead article or one below, its format, cover, digest, byline, "read the original" link and the IP location it was posted from.
- [WeChat Official Account article with its stats](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/articles/full/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/articles/full/get` $0.04 per call. Get a WeChat Official Account article and its current counts in one call by its long link: title, text, time published, the account, and reads, likes, recommends, shares, saves and comments.
- [WeChat Official Account low-follower viral articles](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/articles/trending.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/articles/trending` $0.06 per call. Get the day's list of WeChat Official Account articles read far beyond their account's usual readership, from the last 3, 7 or 30 days, ranked, with reads, likes, recommends, shares, comments and how many times the usual reads they got.
- [WeChat Official Account article stats](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/articles/metrics.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/articles/metrics` $0.02 per call. Get the current counts of a WeChat Official Account article by its long link: reads, likes, recommends, shares, saves, comments.
- [WeChat Official Account comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/comments/replies/list` $0.02 per call. Get the replies under one comment on a WeChat Official Account article, by the comment's ID and the article's link: text, replier, likes, time posted, IP location, which reply each answers. The first batch only; no further pages.
- [WeChat Official Account name search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/accounts/search.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/accounts/search` $0.05635 per item returned, at least $0.06 and at most $0.84525 per call. Find WeChat Official Accounts by name or keyword, closest first: original ID, WeChat ID, name, avatar, owner, and a third-party database's estimates of active followers, lead-article reads and likes, and articles a week (not official, possibly months old). Charged per account; limit sets how many (5 by default, at most 15). Needing the ID and not the estimates, wechat.accounts.search, charged per call, costs less.
- [WeChat Official Account owner](https://dataxapi.com/apis/wechat_mp/accounts/owner/get.md) `GET /v1/wechat_mp/accounts/owner/get` $0.1 per call. Get who a WeChat Official Account is registered to, by its original ID: the owner's name, type, registration number, country, verification status, kind and date, and the account's registration date and authorised third-party services.

## Reddit

- [Reddit post comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/posts/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/reddit/posts/comments/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of comments on a Reddit post by ID or link: text, commenter, score, reply count, time posted, with the first levels of replies.
- [Reddit post detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/posts/get.md) `GET /v1/reddit/posts/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Reddit post by ID or link: title, text, author, community, score, comment count.
- [Reddit post search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/reddit/posts/search` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Reddit posts matching a search, by relevance, newest or top score, optionally within a period.
- [Reddit popular posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/posts/trending.md) `GET /v1/reddit/posts/trending` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the posts on Reddit's Popular feed: title, text, author, community, score, comment count.
- [Reddit community posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/subreddits/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/reddit/subreddits/posts/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the posts of a Reddit community by its name, hot, newest or top score first. Top score is of the last day unless window asks for the last week, month or year, or all time.
- [Reddit trending searches](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/reddit/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get the searches trending on Reddit today, ranked in the order the platform lists them.
- [Reddit user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/users/get.md) `GET /v1/reddit/users/get` $0.002 per call. Get a Reddit user's public profile by username: display name, bio, when it was created, karma, post and comment counts.
- [Reddit user posts](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/users/posts/list.md) `GET /v1/reddit/users/posts/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the posts a Reddit user has made, newest first.
- [Reddit community profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/subreddits/get.md) `GET /v1/reddit/subreddits/get` $0.002 per call. Get a Reddit community by its name: description, members, users active and contributions made in the last week, when it was created.
- [Reddit user active communities](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/users/subreddits/list.md) `GET /v1/reddit/users/subreddits/list` $0.002 per call. Get the communities a Reddit user is active in by username: each one's name, members and icon, all in one page (215 of them were recorded for one account).
- [Reddit video transcript](https://dataxapi.com/apis/reddit/posts/transcript/get.md) `GET /v1/reddit/posts/transcript/get` $0.002 per call. Get what is said in the video of a Reddit post by ID or link: the captions Reddit makes for a video it hosts, as the whole text and timed segments.

## Zhihu

- [Zhihu answer comments](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/answers/comments/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/answers/comments/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of comments on a Zhihu answer: text, commenter, likes, reply count, time posted, IP location.
- [Zhihu answer detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/answers/get.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/answers/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Zhihu answer by ID or link: its question, text, author, time posted.
- [Zhihu article detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/articles/get.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/articles/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Zhihu column article by ID or link: title, text, author, upvotes, comment count, topics.
- [Zhihu search suggestions](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/keywords/related.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/keywords/related` $0.002 per call. Get the suggestions Zhihu's search box lists as a keyword is typed into it (autocomplete), in the order it lists them, about 10 at a time. The words and their places only, with no index.
- [Zhihu column articles](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/columns/articles/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/columns/articles/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the articles in a Zhihu column by the column's ID: title, text, author, time published, upvotes, comment count.
- [Zhihu comment replies](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/comments/replies/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/comments/replies/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the replies under a top-level Zhihu comment: text, replier, likes, which comment each answers. Each reply also gives its IP location.
- [Zhihu pin detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/pins/get.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/pins/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Zhihu pin (short post) by ID or link: text, pictures, author, time posted, likes, comments, saves, reposts.
- [Zhihu content search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/posts/search.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/posts/search` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Zhihu answers and articles matching a search; either kind alone, by relevance, newest or most upvoted.
- [Zhihu question answers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/questions/answers/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/questions/answers/list` $0.002 per call. Get the first 20 answers to a Zhihu question by ID or link, in Zhihu's own order: text, author, upvotes, comment and save counts. One page only.
- [Zhihu question detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/questions/get.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/questions/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Zhihu question by ID or link: title, details, when it was asked, answer, follower and view counts.
- [Zhihu hot list](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/trends/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/trends/list` $0.002 per call. Get Zhihu's hot list: the questions on it, their rank, heat (approximate), answer and follower counts, when each was asked, its summary and picture; an entry's ID is its question's.
- [Zhihu user answers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/users/answers/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/users/answers/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the answers a Zhihu user has written, newest first.
- [Zhihu user articles](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/users/articles/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/users/articles/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the column articles a Zhihu user has written, newest first.
- [Zhihu user followers](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/users/followers/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/users/followers/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the accounts following a Zhihu user, 20 a page: name, headline, avatar, whether an organisation, follower count, answer and article counts.
- [Zhihu user profile](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/users/get.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/users/get` $0.002 per call. Get a Zhihu user's profile by the handle in its address: name, headline, follower count, answer and article counts. It also says whether the user is verified or an organisation, and the IP location.
- [Zhihu user pins](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/users/pins/list.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/users/pins/list` $0.002 per call. Get a page of the pins (short posts) a Zhihu user has posted, newest first: text, pictures, time posted, likes, comments, saves, reposts.
- [Zhihu user search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/zhihu/users/search.md) `GET /v1/zhihu/users/search` $0.002 per call. Get a page of Zhihu users matching a search: name, follower count, answer and article counts. Each also says whether verified, whether an organisation, upvotes received and when they last posted. The headline is in the profile.

## Pinterest

- [Pinterest pin detail](https://dataxapi.com/apis/pinterest/pins/get.md) `GET /v1/pinterest/pins/get` $0.002 per call. Get one Pinterest pin by ID or link: title, description, picture, who pinned it and when, reaction, comment and save counts, the page it points to.
- [Pinterest pin search](https://dataxapi.com/apis/pinterest/pins/search.md) `GET /v1/pinterest/pins/search` $0.002 per call. Find Pinterest pins by search terms: title, description, picture, who pinned it and when, the page it points to. No counts, which the pin capability gives.
